reading_note: The teaching enumerates four (or five) cardinal expressions of self-love operative in the natural mind — gluttony of the body, fornication, the lust for wealth/pride, and war/tyranny — showing them as the works by which the ruling love of self propagates itself across humanity. The arc then pivots from this catalogue of evils to the saving knowledge that separates spiritual light from infernal darkness, the good from the evil, by means of conjunction with the Divine Human in faith, thanksgiving, and obedience — which lifts the regenerating man above all who remain in those four loves.
